Why this shape

Name, source, outcome, save. Source stays selected between calls because agents work in batches down a list.

Call back on

The field the product turns on. One tap, and the contact resurfaces on Today when it matters. Without it this is a spreadsheet with a login page.

Appointment set

Reveals the date inline and writes the appointment row in the same save. Two records, one action — otherwise the funnel's last stage reads zero forever.

Details that decide adoption

  • Date chip reads Today — tap to back-date. Agents batch-log at 8 PM.
  • Optimistic save with Undo, no spinner
  • Offline queue, flushes on reconnect
  • Installs as a PWA, opens beside the dialer
